title: Spirit of the Dancing Cat
description: A surreal night scene features a large green-skinned figure with an elaborate headdress of swirling blue, purple, and yellow hair adorned with red flowers and vines. Below, a black feline spirit with glowing white eyes dances with a woman in a flowing purple dress and blue hair on a stone path surrounded by glowing orbs and twisted trees. Traditional red-roofed pagodas stand in the background under a starry twilight sky.
prompt: A surreal fantasy night scene with a giant green-skinned bald figure in profile whose head explodes into a massive swirling headdress of blue, purple, and yellow hair filled with red flowers and vines. In the foreground, a black cat-like spirit with glowing white eyes dances closely with a woman wearing a flowing purple dress and blue hair. They stand on an ancient stone path surrounded by twisted glowing trees, fireflies, and red pagodas in the misty background under a starry twilight sky.
